summary: Teaches writing PromQL in Code mode for an alert rule on QuickPizza metrics, configuring notifications and creating a silence.

needs.description: QuickPizza tutorial data sources incl. Prometheus data source named grafanacloud-play-prom (installed by the path itself via Demo Data Dashboards app; pre-seeding avoids that step).
Demo Data Dashboards app used to install QuickPizza datasources if not pre-seeded.
Metric quickpizza_server_http_requests_total with status label on grafanacloud-play-prom (query run must succeed).
User with Editor or Admin role able to create alert rules and silences.
needs.evidence: manifest targeting userRoleIn; "Permission to create alert rules"

needs.description: A contact point available to select for the rule.

reviewNotes: Creates rule 'QuickPizza high error rate', folder and silence itself; repeated runs against a shared stack may collide on names.
